verdict.rationale: Attaching custom domains is a fair question for a cloud app-hosting platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents custom domains, TLS certificates for user-owned domains, or DNS setup. The closest items are adjacent: default HTTPS URLs for Sprites and a global Anycast network, neither of which is the ability to attach a user's own domain.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach custom domains to my deployed services
